title: Malicious code in jobwharf (PyPI)
description: The jobwharf package on PyPI version 0.1.0 is part of a malicious campaign involving loader packages that execute code from remote URLs. These packages do not contain the payload themselves but facilitate downloading and running malicious scripts. The campaign is coordinated and intended to deceive users into executing harmful code.
aiSummary: This threat involves the jobwharf package (version 0.1.0) on PyPI, which is identified as part of a coordinated campaign distributing loader packages. These packages enable execution of code fetched from remote URLs, effectively acting as loaders for malicious scripts. Although the packages themselves do not contain the payload, their purpose is to facilitate the delivery and execution of malicious code. The campaign is named '2026-10-voice-synthesis-profiles' and is characterized by its clear malicious intent, including potential infostealer activity. No direct exploit code or active exploitation in the wild has been reported.
aiImpact: The impact is the potential execution of arbitrary malicious code on systems that install and run the jobwharf package version 0.1.0. This can lead to compromise of affected systems, data theft, or other malicious activities depending on the payload delivered by the remote script. Since the package acts as a loader, it can be used to bypass initial detection by not containing the payload directly.
